tei:titleStmt.tei:title: sku lnga'i phrin las dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ma chags pad+ma spyan/ /thugs rje chen po spyan ra
sku lnga'i phrin las dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ma chags pad+ma spyan/ /thugs rje chen po spyan ra

tei:div.tei:p: sku lnga'i phrin las dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so// he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas ma chags pad+ma spyan// thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs// khros pa'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal// gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*// gnod gdug ma lus tshar gcod phyir// chos rgyal sku lnga'i phrin las ni// don bcu'i gnad rnams 'dir bstan bya// de yang mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi gter byon sku lnga'i gsol mchod don bcu'i snying po dril nas nyams su blang ba la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten dang spyan gzigs mthun pa'i dam rdzas za 'og la sogs pa'i rgyal mtshan lnga/ smyug rgod mda' dar mgron bu/ ḍa ma ru sogs phyi rten/ nang rten sku dang bse byang*/ rgyang bor/ bsegs shing*/ spar bu/ tha mkhar/ mchod rten/ gsang rten/ bla rdo/ dam shing rnams sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs te/ rang nyid rta mchog rol pa'i lha'i nga rgyal gyis dang po snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ ho dgongs su gsol lo// ho dgongs su gsaul lo// ho dgongs su gsol lo// dgung sngon mthon po'i yar steng*/ bye ru smug po'i lding khang*/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po sku lnga lcam dral bka' yi blon chen lnga/ nang blon sha grol khyi grol 'dzin sdom dang*/ pa ka rdo rje 'bar ba 'khor dang bcas pa dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren cing mchod cing sgrub pa'i phyir/ sngon tshe dpal chen po rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ nyang nyi ma 'od zer rnams kyis bka' dang dam tshig la dgongs te thugs chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang nas/ sku 'bar ba'i rnam rol gyis rnam par bzhengs te gnas 'dir 'byon par 'tshal lo// dzaḥhūm̐ḥbaṃ hoḥ raḥdzaḥ.aṅku sha sa ma yaḥdza dzaḥ gnyis pa spyan drangs ba la/

spos dang rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis/ hūm̐ḥ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir// ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba'i chos skyong ni/ gnod sbyin rgyal po sde lnga 'khor dang bcas// dam tshig gzhung bzhin srung ba'i skyes mchog khyed// thugs dam rgyud bskul gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bka' yi bstan pa srung ba'i don ched du// chos kyi dbyings nas sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs la// thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// thugs dam rgyud bskul gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// thugs kyi rgyal po brgya byin chen po dang*// yum gcig shin+taṃ ro zan mthu mo che// blon chen srog bdag bka' yi bya ra ba// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsaul// sku yi rgyal po mon bu su tra te// gsang ba'i yum gcig bdud mo ro lang ma// bka' blon shan pa bya khri mig gcig po// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// yon tan rgyal po gnod sbyin shing bya can// gsang ba'i yum gcig gser gyi spu gri ma// bka' yi blon po bya rgod thang nag can// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// gsung gi rgyal po dgra lha skyes gcig po// gsang ba'i yum gcig mdzes byed pad+ma skyes// bka' yi blon po rdo rje grags ldan te// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// phrin las rgyal po zhal gsum mi bo che// gsang ba'i yum gcig bdud za smin dkar ma// bka' yi blon po su tra nag po ste// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ḥbam̐ḥhoḥ a la la ho: ā+e h+ya hi bha ga wan aṅku sha sa ma ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ ma ṭaṃ bsgral ba'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir// kha sbug gan rkyal phyi chings gdan du bsnol// rin chen sna lnga ri rab gzhal yas gzigs// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyis mdzes par spras// ma chags lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rgyal po lnga// yab yum sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// bstan pa bsrung phyir gnyis med brtan par bzhugs// pad+ma ā be sha ya badz+ra ti ru ru sha hūm̐ḥ

badz+ra a ti ka ra yaḥ kha sgyur dkar po sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ a be sha ya s+t+waṃ/ bzhi pa lha rtog gnyis su med pas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ 'jig rten las las grub pa'i dregs pa can// rgyal po chen po sde lnga'i skur sprul pa/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i mthu rtsal can// rgyal po sde lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// a kar+sha a be sha ya e h+ya hi ā ral+li hoḥ lnga pa dam bsre ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa amṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ zhes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te/ hūm̐ḥ skyes mchog dgra lha chen po khyod// bdag dang dbyer med dam bsres na// rdo rje dri chu bdud rtsi mchog /pañtsa amṛ ta dang sbyar// dam tshig snying gi khrag chen po// bsre ba'i mchog te srog gi snying*// snying dang snying gi grogs po byas// rtag tu dam las ma 'da' zhig /badz+ra tri tu rak+ṣa yak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta kha hi/ zhes rang gi lce la bzhag rgyal po la yang gtor bas/ bdag dang rgyal po gnyis med du gyur nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bdag gi bka' nyan cing las byed par bsam zhing dam tshig bsre'o/ drug pa sman mchod bya ba ni/ hoḥ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// bstanapa bsrung phyir 'bar ba'i skur sprul pa// rgyud drug dgongs mdzad rig 'dzin sgrub mchog la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// mthu rtsal drag po'i dngos grub stsal du gsaul// ra tsa a ho bruṃ rbad ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye ho/ sarba pañtsa amṛ ta kha hi/ bdun pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ kye/ dgra lha sku lnga yab yum 'khor bcas la// rnal 'byor bdag gi mchod pa'i dam rdzas ni// rin chen sna tshogs rgyal mtshan dag gis brgyan// mdzes shing yid 'ong zhal zas sna tshogs bshams// 'dod yon lnga yi longs spyod bsam mi khyab// dar gyi lda ldi 'phan gdugs phya ra ra// za 'og gur phub mdzes pa di ri ri// mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan sna tshogs rongs se rong*// rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po kyi li li// sha chen gsur gyi dri ngad spungs se spung*// gser skyems phud kyi rgyun ni brangs se brang*// spos dang tshil chen dud pa thu lu lu// bshos gtsang zhal zas sprin ltar thibs se thib// spyan gzigs sna tshogs rdza ltar khra la la// 'di ltar bshams nas lus kyidakyil 'khor du// gzugs kyi mchod pa sna tshogs bshams nas su// skyes bu chen po'i sku yi rgyan du 'bul// dgyes mdzad sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsaul// rgyal po'i sku mchog deng 'dir dngos su ston// sku yi sprul pas sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs// kye/

skyes bu chen po 'bod pa'i sgra rnams ni// mi rkang mchog gi gling bu di ri ri// sgra snyan sil snyan mang po si li li// pheg rdeb cang te'u mang po khro lo lo// pi waṃ rgyud mang sgra byung brengs se breng*// rnga dang dung dang cha lang la sogs pa// sna tshogs sgra yi mchod pa ji snyed rnams// rgyal po'i gsung gi dkyil 'khor de la 'bul// gsung gi sgra skad deng 'dir dngos su ston// ha ha'i gad mo sdang ba'i dgra la rgod// hi hi'i sdigs mo gnod pa'i bgegs la mdzod// gdug pa'i nga ros thams cad zil gyis gnon// gsung gi sgra skad deng 'dir dngos su ston// dgra lha chen po'i thugs kyi dbyings bstan pa// chos dbyings skye med don la 'gyur ba med// brjod med bsam las 'das pa chos kyi sku// chos kyi mchod pa rgyal po'i thugs la 'bul// brnag pa'i dgongs pa sdang ba'i dgra la mdzod// gdug pa'i bsam ngan sdang ba'i dgra la mdzod// rgyal po'i yon tan brjod kyis mi lang ste// snang srid zil gyis gnon pa yang*// de yang rgyal po'i yon tan yin// 'jig rten 'di na che btsan pa// de yang rgyal po'i yon tan yin// khams gsum dbang du 'du ba yang*// de yang rgyal po'i yon tan yin// grags pa khyad 'phags thob pa yang*// de yang rgyal po'i yon tan yin// rgyal po'i phrin las thogs pa med// dam nyams ru tra'i snying rtsa 'dren// log lta mu stegs mgo bo 'gems// dam nyams tshe yi srog shing gcod// rnal 'byor dgra bo'i gzugs phung 'jig /'di rnams rgyal po'i phrin las yin// dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// sarba pañtsa a ra hoḥ pū dza ho/ ra dza ho/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kha kha khā hi/ dun+taṃ dun+taṃ khā hi/ yak+ṣa nag po khā hi/ sha grol ha ru khā hi/ khyi grol hu ru khā hi/ 'dzin po ru tra khā hi/

sdom po 'chang rgyud khā hi/ hu tra hu tra khā hi/ go ro tsa na khā hi/ tsit+ta ba su ta khā hi/ rak+ta mtshul pa khā hi/ sha rgyud snying rgyud khā hi/ dbang po rnam lnga khā hi/ sha ma ru tri khā hi/ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ho/ su tra badz+ra du ru ho/ brgyad pa bstod cing bsnyen pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ sgrub mchog bdud 'dul ye nas thugs dam can// 'gro ba'i don mdzad thugs rje nyi ma 'dra// dam nyams gdug pa'i dgra bgegs kun sgrol ba// thugs rje snyom mdzad khyed la bdag bstod do// 'gyur med dbyings las 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs la// skye med chos kyi don rtogs rig pa 'dzin// skye shi rtsad gcod legs nyes stangs 'dzin pa// thogs med 'jigs byed khyed la bdag bstod do// chos kyi dbyings las rtse gcig dgongs mdzad pa// g.yas pa'i bdud rtsi'i dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod// g.yon pa'i lcags kyus ru tra'i snying nas 'dren// che ba'i nga rgyal drag pos khams gsum khyab// dgra bgegs ma lus zhal du gsol mdzad cing*// nyon mongs log par lta ba rtsad nas gcod// bdud 'dul mthu chen khyed la bdag bstod do// sku gsung thugs ni chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam// phrin las mthar phyin khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul// drag tu bskul na dgra bgegs dbang du sdud// rgyal po sde lnga'i sku la bdag bstod do// ngang nyid chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// bstan pa srung mdzad drag po'i skur ston pa// rgyal po sde lnga'i thugs dam dgyes bskul ma// yum chen rnam lnga'i sku la bdag bstod do// bka' yi las mkhan mdzad pa'i mthu bo che// rgyal po'i phrin las myur du sgrub pa'i phyir// bcol ba'i las rnams thogs med kun sgrub pa// blon po rnam lnga'i sku la bdag bstod do// sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo la// cho 'phrul bab cing phung du gzhug pa'i phyir// stong gsum sprul pa dmag gis 'geng mdzad pa'i// 'khor gyi ru 'dren rnams la bdag bstod do// de nas bsnyen pa bya ba ni/

bdag nyid dbang chen gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can du ma 'phros/ rgyal chen 'khor bcas kyi thugs dam gnad nas bskul te srog gi snying po rnams mdong gsol gyi tshul du phul nas ci bcol ba'i phrin las thogs med du sgrub par bsam te/ oṃ rā dza a ho bh+ruṃ rbad tsit+ta thibs thibs dzaḥ sha ma ru tri ma ho dzaḥ sarba rā dza sa ma ya thibs thibs dzaḥ zhes bzla'o/ dgu pa gsol zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ hoḥ dbus phyogs thugs kyi rgyal po brgya byin/ chibs su ba glang sna ring la chibs pa/ sna zungs mon bu bha tras byas pa/ sku mdog mthing nag la dar nag dang dom gyi slog pa gsol zhing dbu la dar nag gi 'thib zhu gsol ba/ g.yas pas bdud kyi zhags pas dgra bo 'ching ba/ g.yon pa spu gris dgra snying rtsad nas gcod pa/ zhal nas gdug pa'i ngan sngags sgrogs pa/ rol du glog dang me lce khrid pa/ pho nya thog dang ser ba gtong ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ ta sdang ba'i dgra sod cig gnod pa'i bgegs thul cig phrin las mngon du mdzod cig hoḥ shar phyogs sku'i rgyal po mon bu bha tra seng ge dkar mo la chibs pa/ sku mdog nag po mun ltar gtib pa/ mon tri nag po'i na bza' gsol ba/ dbu la dar nag gi 'thib zhu gsol ba/ g.yas na gser gyi rdo rje gsol zhing brdeg pa/ g.yon pa shel shing bsegs shing bsnams/ rol du dom nag smyon pa khrid pa/ pho nya stag gzigs dom dred gtong ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ sdang ba'i dgra sod cig gnod pa'i bgegs thul cig phrin las mngon du mdzod cig hoḥ lho phyogs yon tan gyi rgyal po gnod sbyin shing bya can chibs su bdud rta nag po la chibs pa/ sku mdog nag po sbrul dang stag gis brgyan pa/ g.yas pa'i dgra s+t+was dgra bo'i mgo lus gshogs pa/ g.yon pas bdud zhags dgra la 'debs pa/ dbu'i khyung mgos lha srin dbang du sdud pa/ rol du srid pa'i g.yu 'brug khrid pa/

pho nya spra spre'u byi la gtong ba la gsol lo/ 'bul lo/ sdang ba'i dgra sod cig gnod pa'i bgegs thul cig phrin las mngon du mdzod cig hoḥ nub phyogs gsung gi rgyal po dgra lha skyes gcig po chibs su drel nag rkang dkar la chibs pa/ sku mdog dmar po 'od du 'bar ba/ sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber dang dbu la rmog zhu gsol ba/ g.yas sba'i 'byang 'khar bsnams nas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa/ g.yon pas tsan+dan gyi bing chen bsnams nas srid pa gsum po 'joms pa/ rol du spyang mo ngur ba khrid pa/ pho nya lcags kyi bya khra gtong ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ sdang ba'i dgra sod cig gnod pa'i bgegs thul cig phrin las mngon du mdzaud cig hoḥ byang phyogs phrin las kyi rgyal po pe ha ra dgra lha chen po zhal gsum g.yas nag g.yon dmar dbus dkar ba/ thod chen gyi steng na sag zhu gdugs thabs su gsol ba/ phyag drug g.yas na lcags kyu mda' dang ral gri/ g.yon pa spu gri gzhu dang ber ka bsnams pa/ rgyud drug rtsad nas gcod cing sku stod la dar dkar ral ka gsol ba/ sku smad zhing lpags stag chas kyis brgyan pa/ chibs su seng ge dkar mo chibs pa/ sna zungs mon bu bha tras byas pa/ rol du rlung nag 'tshub ma khrid pa/ dge bsnyen gzhon nu'i cha byad pho nya bdud bya lcung ka gtong ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ sdang ba'i dgra sod cig gnod pa'i bgegs thul cig phrin las mngon du mdzod cig hoḥ thugs kyi dgra lha'i sprul pa dge bsnyen gzhon nu'i cha byad/ sku la dar dmar gyi ber chen gsol ba/ shel gyi phreng ba'i mgul do byas pa/ g.yas pas sdigs mdzub nam mkhar bsgreng ba/ g.yon pas zangs gri 'debs tshul mdzad pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ hoḥ sku yi dgra lha'i sprul pa'i dge slong dgra bcom gzhon nu'i cha byad chos gos ngur smig gsol ba/ g.yas pas shel gyi bsreg shing bsil ba/ g.yon pas gser gyi spu gri bsnam pa/

ka pa li rgyab tu khur zhing spyi blugs bum pa mdun na 'ching ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ hoḥ yon tan gyi dgra lha'i sprul pa sku mdog sngo skya men tri dmar po'i ga sha can/ g.yas na sba gug mchu ring bsnams pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ gsung gi dgra lha'i sprul pa mthing nag ral pa gyen du brdzes pa/ ag tshom ser nag me ltar 'bar ba/ sku la stag gi slog pa gsol ba/ phyag na zhing gi dbyug pa dang spyang ki'i rgyal mtshan phyar ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ phrin las kyi dgra lha'i sprul pa nag po zhing lpags kyi g.yang gzhi sku la gsol zhing sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan pa/ stag dang spyang ki'i rgyal mtshan phyar ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ sdang ba'i dgra sod cig gnod pa'i bgegs thul cig phrin las mngon du mdzod cig hoḥ thugs kyi rgyal po'i yum gcig shin+taṃ ro zan dmar mo khrag dang zhag gis brgyan pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ hoḥ sku'i rgyal po'i yum gcig bdud mo ro langs ma dkar mo dar dkar gyi go zu gsol ba dam shing dang bhan+dha bsnams pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ hoḥ yon tan gyi rgyal po'i yum gcig gser gyi spu gri nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma dbu la dar nag gi cod paṇa bcing ba/ snyan g.yas sbrul dang dril bus brgyan pa/ g.yon pa seng ge ral pa can/ phyag bzhi g.yas na ral gri dang dung dmar 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa shaka te tri shu li mgul na ba dan 'phyar ba/ mi mgo'i do shal glang chen gyi ko rlon re lde ser po'i sham thabs dang sbrul gyi ska rag bcing ba/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis brgyan pa/ bong bu gwa ba la chibs pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ hoḥ gsung gi rgyal po'i yum mdzes byed pad+ma skyes sku mdog dmar po mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis dam shing bhan+dha bsnams pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ hoḥ phrin las kyi rgyal po'i yum gcig bdud za smin dkar ma mthing nag bdud kyi slog pa gyon pa dam shing bhan+dha bsnams pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/

sdang ba'i dgra sod cig gnod pa'i bgegs thul cig phrin las mngon du mdzod cig hoḥ thugs kyi rgyal po'i blon po srog bdag bka' yi bya ra ba sku la ber smug gsol ba/ seng ge dkar mo la chibs pa/ phyag na dar nag gi ru mtshon phyar ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ hoḥ sku yi rgyal po'i blon po shan pa bya khri mig gcig po sbrul nag thod du bcing ba/ chibs su sngon po sgab nag la chibs pa/ phyag na shel gyi rdo rje 'phen pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ yon tan gyi rgyal po'i blon po bya rgod thang nag dge bsnyen gzhon nu'i cha byad can rdo rje dang tho ba thogs pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ hoḥ gsung gi rgyal po'i blon po rdo rje grags ldan dar gyi chos gos gsol ba rnga mong gwa ba la chibs pa/ shel shing gi bsegs shing bsnams pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ hoḥ phrin las kyi rgyal po'i blon po su tra nag po sku la dar nag gi ral ga gsol ba drel rta nag po la chibs pa/ gri gug phyag na bsnams pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ sdang ba'i dgra sod cig gnod pa'i bgegs thul cig phrin las mngon du mdzod cig hoḥ nang blon sha grol dang khyi grol khol po 'dzin po dang sdom po 'khor dang bcas pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ sdang ba'i dgra sod cig gnod pa'i bgegs thul cig phrin las mngon du mdzod cig hoḥ gnam gyi bla na byis pa lo brgyad pa gnod sbyin rdo rje thog 'bebs la gsol lo 'bul lo/ rdo rje khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ lha'i dge bsnyen chenapo ma hā kā la la gsol lo 'bul lo/ mgon po nag po la gsol lo 'bul lo/ bya rgod thang nag la gsol lo 'bul lo/ srog bdag chen po la gsol lo 'bul lo/ bha tra dkar po la gsol lo 'bul lo/ su tra nag po la gsol lo 'bul lo/ srog bdag rngam pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ dmag dpon chen po la gsol lo 'bul lo/ mthing nag mun ltar 'thib pa'i nang shed na/

gsal byed za 'og gi rgyal mtshan phyar ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ me dpung dmar nag 'bar ba'i nang shed na rngam byed stag gi rgyal mtshan phyar ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ nam mkha' sprin ltar gtibs pa'i nang shed na 'phyo byed seng ge'i rgyal mtshan phyar ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ 'dod chags khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i nang shed na srin mo rma bya'i rgyal mtshan phyar ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ rlung nag 'tshub ma 'khyil ba'i nang shed na za byed spyang ki'i rgyal mtshan phyar ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ dkar mo nyi zla'i 'od kyi nang shed na lding byed bya rgod kyi rgyal mtshan phyar ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ stong gsum sprul pa 'gyed pa'i nang shed na spre'u dang byi la'i rgyal mtshan phyar ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ g.yas kyi ru 'dren dge slong stong gi tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren bhan+dhe nag po a tsa ra'i tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ sngon gyi shul mtshon bdud mo nag mo 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ phyi yi rjes nyul blon po khol po 'dzin pa stag chas dang gzig chas su zhugs pa 'bum phrag stong gi tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ sku yi skyo bsang 'bag seng gar mkhan gyi tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ seng ltar 'phyo ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ stag ltar rngams pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ khyung ltar lding ba la gsol lo 'bul lo/ khra ltar 'dzum pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ spyang ltar rgyug pa la gsol lo 'bul lo/ spu gri mched lnga la gsol lo 'bul lo/ stong dpon mched bdun la gsol lo 'bul lo/ rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams spyan gzigs longs spyod rgyan dang ldan pa 'di bzhes la sdang ba'i dgra sod*/ gnod pa'i bgegs thul/ phrin las mngon du mdzod cig bcu pa las la bskul ba la/ spyi dang sgos kyi bskul pa gnyis las dang po ni/

hūm̐ḥ steng phyogs rnam dag 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas// 'gro ba'i don mdzad 'gro drug gnas 'dir gshegs// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i tshul ston cing*// thugs rje ngang nyid snang srid mtha' la gzigs// dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la// bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams bsgrub par mdzod// rgyal po khyed ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po// nges pa'i don du yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas// kun rdzob tsam du zhing lpags g.yang gzhi gsol// zhe sdang sbrul gyi chun pos sku la brgyan// ru dpon tshul du stag gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin// sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag dpung dgra la drongs// dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di gsol la// bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams bsgrub par mdzod// 'jigs pa'i tshul du ber smug dgu brtsegs gsol// rngams pa'i tshul du zhal gdangs ha ha bzhad// khros pa'i tshul gyis sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs// za byed rtags su spyang ki'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// bka' yi bstan pa srung ba'i don ched du// zhi ba'i ngang las mi bzad khro gtum can// ag tshom ser nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba ni// nyi zla'i thod phreng can yang dbang du sdud// zhabs gnyis brkyang skum stabs kyis bzhugs pa ni// klu yi rgyal khams ma lus zil gyis gnon// phyag mtshan zhing gi dbyug to phyar ba yis// log lta'i dgra bo zhing bcu rdul du brlag /bstan pa srung phyir seng ge dkar mo chibs// sku la spyan gzigs stag gi lpags pa gsol// dgra la rbad na ba glang sna ring chibs// gtum po chen po dom gyi chas ldan pa// phyag mtshan spu gris dgra snying tshal bar 'gem// log par lta ba'i dgra la rbad pa'i tshe// skyes pa mi bzad stag gi chas su zhugs// g.yon gyi lcags kyus 'dren zhing spu gris gtub// thugs dam tshul bzhin drag tu bskul ba'i tshe// gang la bya ba'i dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod// bstan pa gzhung bzhin srung ba'i skyes mchog khyed// rnal 'byor bdag gis bskul zhing rbad pa'i tshe// cho 'phrul ston pa dgra bcom gzhon nu'i tshul// dbu la snyan zhu dar nag 'thibs dang ldan// phyag g.yas tsan+dan g.yon pas bsegs shing bsnams// gsang ba gser gyi rdo rje gsor zhing rdeg

/bdag gi rbad pa'i las rnams 'grub par byed// zhal gsum phyag drug rgyud drug rtsad nas gcod// drel rta chibs nas khams gsum dbang du sdud// phyag mtshan par bu'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol// sba gugs mchu ring dgra bo'i srog rtsa 'dren// shel phreng dkar po yi dam rtag tu 'dzin// dgra s+t+wa kha che dgra bo'i klad pa gshogs// zhabs pa nag pos dgra bo'i bla srog 'gugs// rnal 'byor bdag gis bskul zhing rbad pa'i tshe// dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i las rnams myur du 'grub par mdzod/ sa ma ya dgra bo'i srog la bh+yo bh+yoḥ gnyis pa bye brag tu bskul ba ni/ bh+yoḥ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la// yab gcig gnam lha byang chub dang*// klu mo si waṃ nor 'dzin ma// gnyis med bshos pa'i sras mchog ni// rgyal po chen po pe kar lags// dgung sngon mthon po'i yar steng na// dmu bdud klu tsha sku bzhengs shig /bye ru smug po'i lding khang na// bdud kyi rgyal po sku bzhengs shig /gru gsum mthing nag klong dkyil nas// spu gri 'bar ba sku bzhengs shig /kyeḥ mthon po gnam gyi yar steng na// tshangs pa dung gi thor tshug can// sum cu rtsa gsum gtso bo mdzad// lha yi ded dpon dgra la chos// hor yul kun la mnga' mdzad cing*// shel ging bse yi sag zhu can// bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa'i bdag /pe kar dgra lha chen po chos// bsam yas mthil du bab pa'i tshe// dgra lha chen po rdzu 'phrul can// 'dzam gling ru bzhi'i srog gi bdag /chos skyong chen po dgra la chos// sa dgu'i sems dpa' dgra la chos// rig 'dzin rnal 'byor dbang phyug chos// dbang chen rgyal po dgra la chos// shar phyogs dung gi pho brang nas// zla 'od gzhon nu dgra la chos// lho phyogs gser gyi pho brang nas// mgar ba dbang phyug dgra la chos// gnod sbyin srid pa'i khong seng na// rdzu 'phrul chen po dgra la chos// nub phyogs bye ru'i pho brang nas// badz+ra gu h+ya sa ma yi// dmu rje btsun po dgra la chos// byang phyogs g.yu yi pho brang nas// khyung gshogs 'bar ba dgra la chos// srog bdag chen po dbyings nas bzhengs// zhal gsum stod kyi mi bo che// dmu bdud drang dkar dbyings nas bzhengs// lcags kyi mi bo 'tshub nag can// dgra lha chen po dbyings nas bzhengs// khrag 'thung chen po dbyings nas bzhengs// nad kyi bdag po dbyings nas bzhengs// nor kyi bdag po dbyings nas bzhengs// stong dpon chen po dbyings nas bzhengs// thugs kyi yum gcig dbyings nas bzhengs// shin+taṃ ro zan sku bzhengs shig

/sku yi yum mchog sku bzhengs shig /bdud mo ro langs sku bzhengs shig /yon tan yum mchog dbyings nas bzhengs// gser gyi spu gri sku bzhengs shig /gsung gi yum mchog sku bzhengs shig /mdzes byed pad+ma sku bzhengs shig /phrin las yum mchog sku bzhengs shig bdud za smin dkar sku bzhengs shig /thugs blon srog bdag bya ra bzhengs// sku blon bya khra'i mig gcig bzhengs// blon po bya rgod thang nag bzhengs// gsung blon rdo rje grags ldan bzhengs// blon chen su tra nag po bzhengs// nang blon sha grol khyi grol bzhengs// 'dzin sdom rdo rje 'bar ba bzhengs// 'khor gyi ru 'dren sde bzhi po// skyes pa stag chas zhugs pa brgya// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo// dge slong khrims chas zhugs pa brgya// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo// bud med bag chas zhugs pa brgya// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo// sngags pa zor chas zhugs pa brgya// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo// a tsar spos phor thogs pa brgya// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo// sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang*// bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pa bzhes// ma g.yel ma g.yel dgra la chos// zhe sdang gdug pa'i sems kyi chos// 'dod chags 'dzin pa'i sems kyis chos// gti mug nga rgyal stobs kyis chos// phrag dog khros pa'i sems dang bcas// dam nyams sdang ba'i dgra bo la// drang srong dmod pa'i sngags thun phob// gdug rtsub mtshon gyi char pa phob// sreg byed me yi tshwa tshwa dang*// gnam lcags rdo rje'i char chen pos// gshis ngan 'gum pa bcu gsum gyis// dam nyams srog rtsa rtsad nas chod// zhe sdang can rnams rdul du rlog /gti mug can rnams rlung la rbad// 'dod chags can rnams skye rgyud chod// rgyab brten can rnams lha dang phyes// nga rgyal can rnams thal bar rlog

/ban dgra nag po chams la phob// nad kyi rlung dmar dgra la thob// tshon gyi gru gu dgra la rkyongs// glo bur ye 'drog dgra la thob// ltas ngan phung brlag dgra la thongs// smyo 'bog rengs shing brgyal du chug /bdud chod mdangs 'phrog dum bur gtub// rlung gi gtor ma gtor bar mdzod// rdul phran tsam yang med pa dang*// ming tsam med par thal bar rlog /ces thal mo dang dul mo brdab nas bskul lo// bka' gnyan pas gar thod thod du mi bya'o// rnam par snang mdzad ye shes gangs chen mtsho// rnam pa'i tshul du sa dgu'i sems dpa' che// gsang sngags nang gi bka' yi srung mar bzhengs// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i thun min srung ma yin// de phyir sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*// 'dzin spel dam pa khri sde btsan po dang*// sprul pa'i gter chen nyi ma 'od zer dang*// rgyal ba 'brom dang bya 'dul 'dzin pa dang*// dga' ldan khri ba blo bzang rgya mtsho yis// phrin las mdzad pa mkha' khyab spel ba sogs// chos skyong chen po 'di min gzhan su zhig /lo rgyus rang rang rnam thar gzhung la dris// chos kyi spyan ldan rnams kyis brten bsten pa// las myur rno la 'khu ldog chung ba yi// rgyal chen phrin las gsang ba'i byang bu 'di// pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba dge/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
